responsibility: Provides PA-RISC ELF object-format assembler and driver definitions shared by ELF-based PA targets. It switches the backend to ELF mode, sets start/end files and basic section directives, and overrides external symbol and function declaration emission so PA-specific .EXPORT/.IMPORT conventions, libcall imports, and assembler file-start handling work correctly when pa.cc and pa.md generate ELF assembly.
